definitions.explanation: The act of blaming oneself for something that went wrong or for a perceived failing.

examples.english: To be tormented by feelings of self-blame.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{自責|じせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんでいる→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: He is suffering from self-blame over the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{時|とき}⟦{止|と}めていれば→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{自責|じせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えない→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: I can't shake the feeling of self-blame, thinking I should have stopped it then.

notes:
{自責|じせき} is a noun meaning self-blame. It most commonly appears in the set phrase {自責|じせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ (feelings of self-reproach).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自責|じせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ (feelings of self-blame)
- {自責|じせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}られる→駆る：14715_karu⟧ (to be driven by self-reproach)
- {自責|じせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧ (to suffer from self-blame)
- {自責|じせき}{点|てん} (earned run — in baseball)

USAGE:
In emotional/psychological contexts, {自責|じせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ is the standard phrase. In baseball, {自責|じせき}{点|てん} refers to an earned run (a run for which the pitcher is responsible), giving the word a completely different usage in sports contexts.
